Interactive D3 bump chart

pv_bump.Rd

Rank over time: the top_n entities at the final time point, drawn as lines through their rank (1 at the top) at every time point, with a dot at each measurement. Crossing lines are the story — they mark the moment one entity overtook another. Entity names label both ends of each line, at its starting and finishing rank, nudged apart where they would collide. Hovering a line raises it, dims the rest, and reads out the rank and value at the nearest time point.

Usage

pv_bump(
  data,
  time,
  id,
  value,
  top_n = 10,
  title = NULL,
  subtitle = NULL,
  mode = "auto",
  duration = 800,
  source = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame in long form: one row per entity per time point (missing combinations mean the entity is absent then).

time

Name of the time column — numeric (e.g. a year) or Date. At least 2 distinct time points are required.

id

Name of the column identifying each racing entity.

value

Name of the numeric column the entities race on (non-negative; NA counts as absent).

top_n

How many rank positions are shown, and how many entities are drawn — the top_n by value at the final time point (a whole number, at least 2; capped at the number of entities present then).

title, subtitle

Optional chart heading text.

mode

"auto" (default: follow the viewer's light/dark setting), "light", or "dark".

duration

Tempo control: each step between consecutive time points takes duration / 500 * 900 ms, so the default 500 gives roughly 900 ms per step. 0 skips the animation entirely and shows the final time point — no autoplay, but the replay control stays, and pressing it runs the race at the default tempo.

source

Optional source/credit line, shown small and grey at the bottom left — e.g. "Source: Bundesamt für Statistik".

width, height, elementId

Standard htmlwidgets sizing arguments.

Value

An htmlwidget.

Details

Ranks are computed among all entities in data at each time point, but only positions 1 to top_n are drawn. An entity that sits outside the top top_n at some time points has no position to show there, so its line simply spans the times where it ranks — entering late, or breaking where it dipped out. Colours follow the final standings in palette-slot order; beyond the palette's 8 slots the colours repeat, faded toward the background.

Examples

pv_bump(pv_city_population, time = "year", id = "city",
        value = "population", top_n = 10,
        title = "Switzerland's largest cities, reranked",
        source = "Source: Bundesamt für Statistik")
